title: Perfect BigA$$ Salad Bowls
text: Perfect BigA$$ Salad Bowls. I got these for large salads and for pastas and I am not disappointed. They are also great for Buddha Bowls. I personally prefer a deeper bowl for soup so they are not my go to for soups.

Easy to clean and hold: DOWAN salad bowls are designed with elegant ripples, which is easy-holding and clean by hand-washing or dishwasher.Dishwasher, microwave, freezer, and oven safe
